Mahabharat ke sabse mahaan yoddhaon mein se ek
Karn...
jiske paas janm se hi aisa divya kavach aur kundal the,
jo use lagbhag ajey banaate the.
Lekin kya tum jaante ho,
jis yoddha ko poori duniya Sootputra samajhti rahi,
woh asal mein Kunti ka sabse bada beta tha!
Aakhir ek raajkumari ne apne hi bete ko janm lete hi nadi mein kyon baha diya?
Is rahasya ki shuruaat tab hui,
jab Rishi Durvasa ne raajkumari Kunti ko ek aisa divya mantra diya,
jisse woh kisi bhi devta ka aahvaan kar sakti thi.
Ek din jigyaasavash
Kunti ne us mantra se Surya Dev ka aahvaan kar diya.
Aur tabhi Surya Dev unke saamne prakat ho gaye.
Kunti ghabra gayi.
Unhone bataaya ki unhone yeh mantra sirf uski shakti parakhne ke liye istemaal kiya tha.
Lekin Surya Dev ke vardaan se woh garbhvati ho gayi.
Kuch samay baad Kunti ne ek aise putra ko janm diya,
jiske shareer par janm se hi sone ka kavach aur kaanon mein divya kundal the.
Yeh koi saadhaaran baalak nahi tha.
Woh Surya Dev ka putra tha.
Lekin ab
Kunti ke saamne sabse bada sankat tha.
Woh avivaahit thi.
Unhe darr tha ki agar is bachche ke janm ka sach saamne aa gaya,
toh samaaj mein unki badnaami hogi.
Aur phir unhone ek aisa faisla liya, jiska dard shaayad zindagi bhar unke dil mein raha.
Unhone apne navjaat bete ko ek tokri mein rakha aur nadi mein baha diya.
Lekin kismat ne us bachche ko marne nahi diya.
Woh tokri ek saarthi Adhirath ko mili.
Adhirath aur unki patni Radha ne us bachche ko apna beta bana liya
aur uska naam rakha
Vasushen.
Yahi bachcha aage chalkar Karn bana...
Mahabharat ka mahaan dhanurdhar.
Lekin sabse bada durbhaagya dekho...
Karn jis maa ki pehchaan ke liye zindagi bhar anjaan raha,
wahi Kunti uski asli maa thi.
Jis bete ko usne kabhi apnaane ki himmat nahi ki,
wahi beta aage chalkar uske doosre beton ke khilaaf yuddh karne waala tha.
Aur shaayad Karn ki zindagi ka sabse bada dukh yahi tha...
ki use duniya se apni pehchaan saabit karne ke liye poori zindagi ladna pada,
jabki uski asli pehchaan uski maa ke paas hi chhipi thi.
